GSE134431.comparator_boundary: Eight nonulcerated diabetic foot-skin samples are contextual comparators, not healing-outcome controls.
GSE134431.independence_boundary: One public RNA-seq sample per DFU participant. Donor #31 and UM#31W4 remain a suspected cross-context linkage only; use 21 conservative units and report a possible minimum of 20.

GSE143735.defensible_contrast: Forearm skin from DFU healers versus nonhealers versus diabetes without ulcer.
GSE143735.comparator_boundary: All biopsies are nonulcerated forearm whole skin; this cannot validate a local DFU-ulcer tissue signature.
GSE143735.independence_boundary: 13 samples map to 13 source participant aliases; Supplementary Table 5 has concordant 4/5/4 group counts.

GSE199939.defensible_contrast: Diabetic foot skin versus non-diabetic foot skin at sample-metadata level.
GSE199939.comparator_boundary: Series, BioProject, and publication call the diabetic group DFU; all 21 sample and BioSample records annotate only foot skin and diabetes status, with no ulcer field.
GSE199939.independence_boundary: 21 unique donor aliases and one sample per alias; participant independence is defensible, ulcer-tissue identity is not sample-level verifiable.

GSE165816.defensible_contrast: DFU healer versus nonhealer with diabetes-no-DFU and healthy comparators, stratified by tissue.
GSE165816.comparator_boundary: Foot, forearm, and PBMC libraries are different biological compartments and must never be pooled as exchangeable samples.
GSE165816.independence_boundary: The primary supplement maps all 54 public libraries to 27 participants: 7 DFU healers, 4 nonhealers, 6 diabetes-no-DFU, and 10 healthy participants.

author_decisions_required.question: Approve quarantining GSE199939 from core DFU analyses and retaining it only as diabetic-foot-skin context or a separately labeled sensitivity analysis?
author_decisions_required.reason: Ulcer status is asserted at series/publication level but absent from every sample-level and BioSample tissue/disease field.
